ideas.title: Minnesota Human Services Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the potential fraud within Minnesota's human services system and the impact of Gov. Tim Walz's plan to 'transform' the system.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and data analysis to uncover potential mismanagement and fraud
questions: What is the extent of the potential fraud?

ideas.insight: As an investigator, I believe this story matters because it involves potential mismanagement of public funds and the impact on Minnesota's human services system.
